cursor.workflow_mechanism: native repository Agent Skills at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; documented explicit invocation /<skill-name>; implicit matching may occur inside the current human task
notes: Project rules remain relevance/file scoped and no ADF rule is intentionally alwaysApply=true.
Cursor natively discovers .agents/skills and also Claude skill directories; DMTZ therefore avoids duplicate .claude/skills copies.
A root CLAUDE.md is intentionally not used because Cursor also loads root CLAUDE.md as always-on context; Claude uses .claude/CLAUDE.md instead.

claude_code.workflow_mechanism: thin .claude/commands/<name>.md bridges invoke the canonical .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md workflow with /<name>; no duplicate semantic .claude/skills copy
notes: Claude Code follows the open Agent Skills standard and normally discovers project skills in .claude/skills; DMTZ uses command bridges to keep one canonical cross-tool workflow source.
Existing Claude command files remain supported even though native skills are recommended for richer packaging.
Subagent/team-based repository implementation remains outside the current human-directed scope.

codex.scoped_rules: nested AGENTS.md supported when future directory-specific need is demonstrated
codex.workflow_mechanism: native repository Agent Skills at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; documented explicit selection uses $<skill-name> or /skills
notes: Codex documentation identifies .agents/skills as the repository skill location and supports implicit description matching as well as explicit selection.
No Codex-specific semantic rulebook is required.
Model identity/version is intentionally not pinned by repository semantic authority.

deferred: CI enforcement and automated drift validation (ADF-F)
